page_title: NEW 1-3 NOT | Newcastle v Nottingham Forest 26/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Chris Kavanagh is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' A quickly taken corner by Newcastle.
90+6' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The referee blows his whistle, Newcastle are awarded a corner kick.
90+5' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) controls a cross inside the box and sends a low drive towards the left post, but one of the defenders reacts superbly to block his effort.
90+3' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
90+2' Cheikhou Kouyate (Nottingham) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. Newcastle earn a free kick.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The substitution has been made. Cheikhou Kouyate (Nottingham) has replaced Danilo.
90' Nuno Espirito Santo has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Joe Worrall (Nottingham) replacing Anthony Elanga.
89' The attendance is 52207.
88' Chris Kavanagh shows a yellow card to Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) for a tough tackle.
87' The free kick is delivered by Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
86' Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Chris Kavanagh has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. That's a free kick to Nottingham.
85' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) picks up a yellow card.
84' Neco Williams (Nottingham) is yellow-carded for breaking the rules of the game.
84' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
84' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Newcastle have a corner.
82' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Matt Turner, who smothers the ball.
80' Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Callum Hudson-Odoi.
79' Eddie Howe prepares a substitution. Sven Botman is replaced by Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd).
79' Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) misses a great opportunity to convert the free kick from the edge of the penalty box after firing the ball high over the crossbar of the goal.
78' Ola Aina (Nottingham) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Chris Kavanagh blows for a foul. Newcastle have a free kick.
77' Neco Williams (Nottingham) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
74' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Chris Kavanagh stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
74' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.

73' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) latches on to a precise lofted cross inside the box, controls the ball and drills a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. His dangerous effort is blocked by Matt Turner, who makes a glorious save!
71' Today's match ends for Sean Longstaff who will be replaced by Joelinton (Newcastle Utd).
71' Ola Aina (Nottingham) tries his luck with and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but it is blocked by one of the defenders.
70' Nuno Espirito Santo decides to make a substitution. Gonzalo Montiel will be replaced by Neco Williams (Nottingham).
70' Ibrahim Sangare comes off the pitch to be replaced by Ryan Yates (Nottingham).
69' Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd) tricks his way to the edge of the box where he shoots at goal. The keeper scrambles to cover the effort, but it goes just wide of the left post.
69' A cross from Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
68' Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd) rises high to meet a cross from the corner kick and plants a header from inside the penalty area. His effort went just narrowly wide of the left post.
68' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

67' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it. Newcastle have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
67' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
67' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
65' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
63' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
62' Referee Chris Kavanagh points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. That prompts big celebrations from the Nottingham players.
61' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Nottingham players aren’t happy.
60' 1 - 3 Chris Wood (Nottingham) runs on to a clever pass from Murillo and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He still has work to do but finishes with aplomb into the back of the net.
58' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) sends a cross into the box, but Matt Turner comes off his line to gather the ball.
57' He should have scored! Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
55' Eddie Howe has decided to make a change. Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) replaces Dan Burn.
55' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd) comes onto the pitch so that Miguel Almiron can be given a rest.
53' 1 - 2 Goal! Anthony Elanga provides Chris Wood (Nottingham) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a strike into the middle of the goal. 1:2.
52' The corner from Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) is intercepted by the defence.
51' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the net, but Martin Dubravka is alert and denies him.

50' What an opportunity! Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) leaps high to meet a beautiful cross into the box from the free kick, and he plants a header from near the penalty spot which goes a whisker wide of the left post.
49' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
49' Moussa Niakhate (Nottingham) commits a rough challenge and Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle for an infringement. A free kick to Newcastle.
48' A player from Newcastle commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
48' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner.

48' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The linesman makes the right call and Newcastle will have a corner.
47' The ball is cleared after Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
46' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) launches himself at a lofted pass, but his close-range header flies just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Newcastle will have a goal kick.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.

45+4' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) dribbled past his opponents before finding himself in a great position to strike. But his low attempt from just outside of the box went straight towards the middle of the goal and Martin Dubravka made a comfortable save.

45+4' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the roof of the net. His effort, however, is blocked by Matt Turner, who pulls off a stunning save!
45+4' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
45+3' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent.
45+1' 1 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Anthony Elanga sprays a pass out to Chris Wood (Nottingham), and he has an easy job to slot the ball into an empty net. The score is 1:1.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd).
44' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) is adjudged offside.
43' Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball into the stands. Nice run, but poor finish!
43' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Martin Dubravka intercepts the ball.
41' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
40' Bruno Guimaraes is not given a chance to finish after receiving a sweet pass by Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd).
37' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.

36' Matt Turner pulls off a decent save! Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the middle of the net, but the effort is kept out.
36' A pass lands at the feet of Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
35' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
35' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) sends a chip pass into the box, but Matt Turner is quickest to intercept the ball. Good work from Newcastle as they win a corner.
35' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

34' Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Newcastle.
34' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it to the middle of the goal, but Martin Dubravka makes a comfortable save to stop his effort.
31' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) spurns a great opportunity from inside the 6-yard box. The ball flies narrowly wide of the left post.
27' The game is interrupted. Gonzalo Montiel (Nottingham) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
27' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) sees a yellow card from Chris Kavanagh after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
27' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
26' Ibrahim Sangare (Nottingham) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Chris Kavanagh ignores the protests.
23' 1 - 0 Goal! Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Matt Turner to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom right corner.
23' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
22' Referee Chris Kavanagh is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Newcastle!
22' Celebrations by Newcastle are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.

21' Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle after Ola Aina (Nottingham) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. The referee makes a call and blows his whistle for an infringement. Newcastle are awarded a penalty.
19' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
19' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Newcastle get a corner.
19' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
17' Ola Aina (Nottingham) takes a snap shot from the edge of the box after a rebound, but his effort is a waste as it goes high over the bar.
17' A dangerous looking corner kick from Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) is cleared to safety by the defence.
13' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
12' Sven Botman (Newcastle Utd) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.

10' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
10' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Chris Kavanagh blows for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Newcastle.
9' Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
8' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

7' Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball goes behind for a corner. Newcastle will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
7' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Chris Kavanagh saw the whole situation.
5' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
4' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham).

4' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger. The ball is out of play and Nottingham manage to earn a corner.
3' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) gets a shot from inside the penalty area and it flies just wide of the left post.
1' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) takes it short.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Newcastle will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Chris Kavanagh.
